info.title: NAE_Condition_Event
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

event.description: Notification sent when a NAE Condition is met on  the Time Series Database. The keys of this map will contain the timestamp in epoch when the Condition is met along with the current value of the Monitors associated with the Condition.

nae_condition.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Condition_Event](#/NAE_Condition_Event)
Contains references to each entry in the [NAE Condition Table][NAE_Condition]

name.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Condition_Event](#/NAE_Condition_Event)
Unique name of the condition event.

processed_actions_count.description: Count of the actions that were executed for the condition event

status.description: Condition Notification status: * `PENDING`: The notificiation is waiting to be processed. * `PROCESSING`: The notification is being processed.

uri_resources.description: List of URIs of all resources associated with the event.

parameters.name: NAE_Script.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Script](#/NAE_Script)
Name of a NAE Script. This has to be a valid canonical name (CNAME) (i.e com.arubanetworks.bgp_monitor).

parameters.name: NAE_Agent.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Agent](#/NAE_Agent)
Name of a NAE Agent. This has to be a CNAME starting with NAE Script name followed by its own name (i.e com.arubanetworks.bgp_monitor.agent1).

parameters.name: NAE_Rule.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Rule](#/NAE_Rule)
Rules created by the particular NAE Agent.

parameters.name: NAE_Condition.condition_type
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Condition](#/NAE_Condition)
Conditions associated with the rule CONDITION : Condition associated with the rule CLEAR_CONDITION : Optional clear condition associated with the rule

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
